comment: A noise stroke that bends keeps the holes it has when it runs straight. On a white 1200 by 900 document, black, at a pressure of 0.15 throughout and under a pen leaning (35, 20) degrees, each preset at its own radius with Randomness at nought, so every stroke reads one field, paints four strokes of 520 pixels with a sample every 1.5 pixels: a straight one top left slanting down by 0.17 radians, and arcs of radius 600 top right, 300 below left and 150 below right. Thick Impasto on the first document, Grain Round on the second.
